title: Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Yannai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) Of his teachers we find only, in Tosefta Zavim 1:2, that he spoke in the name of Rabbi Elazar Chisma before Rabbi. Hyman argues that Rabbi Yannai his father is not the Rabbi Yannai who was Rabbi’s student, since that Rabbi Yannai too is not mentioned in any baraita — how then would his son be mentioned? He considers it likely that he is the son of the Rabbi Yannai mentioned in Avot 4:15. His halakhot remain to us through his student Rabbi Elazar ben Antigenos, who always spoke in his name, as explained in his entry.

notes.text: The chronological exclusion, negative baraita observation, proposed Yannai father and always-reporting student relationship are Hyman’s argument. Always retains the supplied force.

The consulted Machon Mamre Tosefta Zavim 1:2 directly has Elazar son of Yannai transmitting Elazar Chisma before Rabbi. Hyman’s father identification, chronological exclusion and “always” characterization are retained as his argument.
